spec.description: QW importance_s025 batch2 (problems 51-100) accuracy eval with max_new_tokens=8192, fixing original batch2 which used 2048

experiment_data.hypothesis: 重跑 QW s025 batch2 (problems 51-100) with max_new_tokens=8192，修复原 batch2 使用 2048 的不一致问题。

reproduce.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/pacs && python run_accuracy_eval.py --model checkpoints/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct --conditions importance_s025 --num-problems 50 --start-index 50 --max-new-tokens 8192 --gpu cuda:0 --seed 42 --output-name accuracy_eval_qw_s025_b2_fix.json"
